name: Veggie Ground "Meatloaves" with Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Coat 12 muffin cups with oil and set aside.
Peel and mince onion; place in a medium bowl.
Add veggie ground, eggs, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onions. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 oz veggie ground, plant based
2 eggs
½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place ketchup, Dijon, and brown sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp ketchup
2 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide veggie ground mixture between the muffin cups and top with ketchup glaze. Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.

Wash, dry, trim, and peel carrots. Slice lengthwise into quarters. Place on a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and bake until golden and fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain, and return to the pan.
Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) whole milk
4 tsp butter, unsalted
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the "meatloaves", roasted carrots, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!
